includes: A case (12 x 500ml bottles) of cider three times a year (spring, summer and fall)

blurb: Left Field Cider Co. produces small batch, full juice cider using a blend of English, French cider apples and BC dessert apples. They offer a variety of ciders including dry, hopped, and infused options. The cider is made to be enjoyed in any way the drinker prefers, with no strict rules on consumption.
extraNote: Memberships can be cancelled by emailing club@leftfieldcider.com at least 10 days prior to the 1st of April, July or October · Located on Hwy 97C between Merritt and Logan Lake.
